name: OFF-ROAD EXPLORER
author: KING_CH888
description:
Off-Road Explorer is a realistic arcade driving game set in a captivating open world environment featuring diverse landscapes.

Experience the Free Roam mode and explore limitlessly across the vast terrain including the dirt track twisting and winding through lush forest vegetation, gigantic boulders and a freshwater lake... Or challenge yourself in the Coin Collector mode where your mission is to collect 100 coins as quickly as possible! Adventure awaits... Will you set the fastest time?

Created By Chi Ho Lau
